MemoriaHub CLI v1.3.4
Usage: memoriahub [options] [command]

Import and sync photos/videos into MemoriaHub

Options:
  -V, --version                      Print the installed version
  --no-color                         Disable colored output (also respects
                                     NO_COLOR env)
  -h, --help                         display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]                    Authenticate with a MemoriaHub server
  import [options] <folder>          One-shot import: register a folder and
                                     sync it immediately (alias for sync
                                     <folder>)
  sync [options] [folder...]         Incremental sync: skip already-uploaded
                                     files, process new/changed files
  scan [options] [folder...]         Dry-run scan: preview and persist the file
                                     set a sync would process
  organize [options] [folder...]     Move files into YEAR/MM - Month/ folders
                                     by EXIF capture date (undated → NODATE/)
  screenshots [options] [folder...]  Find files with 'screenshot' in the name
                                     (case-insensitive); list, move, or delete
                                     matches
  convert [options] [path...]        Convert video files (MOV, MTS, AVI, WMV,
                                     …) to MP4 (requires ffmpeg)
  date-infer                         Infer missing capture dates from filenames
                                     (diagnose report or write via ExifTool)
  status [options]                   Show sync status: folder overview or
                                     recent run history
  folders                            Manage the set of folders watched by
                                     MemoriaHub
  circles                            Manage the active circle for uploads
  retry [options]                    Retry failed uploads (up to the attempts
                                     cap). Use --force to also retry blocked
                                     files.
  settings                           View and update CLI settings (concurrency,
                                     attempts cap, etc.)
  backup                             Local media backup to a folder on this
                                     machine (node-based)
  jobs|queue [options]               Live job queue dashboard (server load,
                                     ETA)
  reports                            Run extensible sync/storage reports from
                                     local state
  node                               Run this machine as a worker node that
                                     processes the enrichment queue
  workflow                           List and run Media Workflow Automation
                                     workflows
  android [options]                  Build, sign, version and publish the
                                     Android app
  menu                               Launch the interactive terminal UI
                                     (requires a TTY)
  help [command]                     display help for command
